scripts.predev: docker start sast-postgres 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name sast-postgres -e POSTGRES_USER=sast -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=sast -e POSTGRES_DB=sast_arena -p 5433:5432 postgres:16-alpine; sleep 2 && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://sast:sast@localhost:5433/sast_arena pnpm --filter api db:migrate
scripts.dev: clear && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:web"
